list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete cluster anion comprises two identical tetravacant [Se2W14O52]12− Dawson-type subunits fused through a nearly coplanar [SeO4Eu5(H2O)8]11+ pentanuclear unit, with Eu–O–W linkers; the pentanuclear unit contains five Eu(III) ions.

synthesis.ph: Adjusted to 5.55; after heating 5.48; crystals obtained at pH 5.57
synthesis.procedure: Na2SeO3, Na2WO4·2H2O, H2pdca, and dimethylamine hydrochloride were added consecutively to water. The pH was adjusted with HCl, then Eu(NO3)3·6H2O was added and the pH readjusted with NaOH. The solution was heated in a water bath, cooled to room temperature, and slowly evaporated to crystallize.
